status: K1-prime reuse ceiling measured; a sound partial memo key exists for closed summary calls, the majority of calls stay open

probe.where: boon_compiler_kernel solver summary_call, debug-only and env-gated by BOON_KERNEL_TRACE_REUSE
probe.classification: resolves each call input term without mutation, marks the call closed when no resolved term contains a live variable, and groups closed calls by (definition, resolved input term ids) while tracking the distinct requirement targets seen per class
probe.production_impact: none; the probe is absent from release producers

findings: About 35% of summary calls have fully closed resolved inputs; the remaining 65% carry live variables and cannot be keyed by resolved terms alone.

Closed calls repeat heavily: 3,743 of 3,911 TodoMVC closed calls (95.7%) share their (definition, input terms) class with at least one other call, forming only 168 classes; NovyWave is 1,793 of 1,936 in 143 classes.

No closed call lacks a requirement channel: closed_without_backflow is zero on TodoMVC, so a transfer cache must separate the reusable value/requirement shape from per-occurrence requirement destinations.

Per-class requirement targets fragment widely (up to 103 distinct targets in one TodoMVC class), confirming the architecture plan's split between reusable parametric transfer and per-occurrence bindings.

A closed-call memo can therefore remove roughly a third of summary evaluation work, but it cannot by itself restore K0 latency; the open-call majority needs a parametric skeleton or linked code, or the evaluated fallback.

transfer_stability_at_quiescence.method: for each closed class, capture the evaluated value term and the accumulated requirement term per input, canonicalize unbound contextual holes exactly as summary_call publishes them, resolve deeply, and compare every repeat against the first capture
transfer_stability_at_quiescence.not_noise: the first comparison on raw ids and the second on deeply resolved ids produced identical mismatch counts, so the value agreement is not an interning artifact; canonicalizing unbound contextual holes is what removed the 426 TodoMVC raw-id differences

decision: The value half of a closed transfer is a pure function of the definition and resolved input terms, but the requirement half is not: 84 TodoMVC and 4 NovyWave repeats produce different closed requirement terms for identical inputs. A sound memo key must therefore cover the dependency state behind the requirement side, not just the input tuple, and no such key exists today. Implement the value-reuse experiment next (cache node values per closed class and replay the requirement accumulation per call) to measure the achievable win; if it cannot restore K0-class latency, the reviewed fallback is to evaluate through linked residual specialization with shared bytes.
